title: AC1024 associative constraint-group seed/count framing
scope: Read the same-input AC1024 constraint-group next-node-ID seed and inline node count with bounded handling; complete only empty version-0 and version-2 zero-seed profiles, and retain all nonempty or alternate layouts as raw/unvalidated.

behavior: Retain the next-node-ID seed separately from node count and copy/reset both state fields with DRW_AssociativeObject.
Decode nonnegative seed then bounded count for the AC1024 version-0 inline profile.
For version 2, stop after a nonzero seed so a possible registry root is not misread as an inline count.
Keep nonempty node lists partial and raw until class names, connections and class-specific bodies are decoded.
Keep strict associative DXF export refusal active.
generatedCases: Version-2 empty group with zero seed.
Version-0 empty group with seed 523 and count zero.
Version-0 nonempty group remains partial after seed/count framing.
Over-bound action and node counts preserve raw data and following-object recovery.
Negative seed stops before consuming a node count.
Version-2 nonzero seed stops before consuming a possible registry root.

validation.asanEnvironmentNote: Explicit ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1 aborts because this platform reports leak detection unsupported; the same focused test passed with default ASan options.
validation.realSourceResult: Expected strict refusal: debug reports seed=523 and nodeCount=399, the associative output preflight returns dwg-associative-graph-not-serialized, and no DXF file is created.

nextAction: Decode the detached node class-name stream, node IDs/connections and the first source-observed class-specific bodies with per-field bounds; keep unsupported remainder raw and strict export refusal active.
